notes:
Latest call notes (shorthand):
- Customer: Elmbridge (flash-sale marketplace for boutique retailers). heavy refunds + order-churn in promos.
- Wants agent-assist + automated refunds via API (Stripe + internal refunds service).
- Quote from Ops head: "We need 99.9% availability during peak promos, and zero double-refunds."
- Priorities: 1) reliable tool-calls to tickets/refund endpoints; 2) concise assistant summaries for CSR handoff; 3) fast routing to escalation queues; 4) audit trail for every tool action.
- Current stack: Zendesk for tickets, Stripe/Braintree for payments, internal fulfillment service behind VPC.
- Existing pain: webhook retry chaos, idempotency not enforced, inconsistent annotations on Zendesk tickets, manual refund approvals slow.
- POC asks: simulate 1k->5k rps bursts, replayable audit logs, signed tool-call traces, ability to toggle automatic refunds (safe-mode), role-based approval flow for >$500 refunds.
- Security questions: PCI scope, encryption-in-transit+at-rest, KMS integration, IP allowlist for private endpoints, SSO/SAML for Redwood Console, retention policy for transcripts (default 90d -> need 180d opt).

use_case_summary: Fast agent-assist with integrated tool-calls: 1) detect refund intents from chat or phone transcripts; 2) create/update Zendesk tickets with structured metadata; 3) call payments API to issue refunds (with idempotency and approval gating); 4) escalate to specialist queues when signals indicate fraud or high-value orders. Must support bursty traffic (marketing promos) and provide immutable audit logs for every tool action.
integration_requirements: Zendesk tickets API - create/update with custom fields (order_id, refund_amount, approval_state)
Payments gateway (Stripe/Braintree) - refund API with idempotency keys and webhook verification
Internal refunds service - VPC-only endpoint, mutual TLS preferred
Webhook retry/poison queue handling - ability to surface failed tool-calls in Console
SAML SSO and RBAC for Redwood Console access
poc_scope: 1-month POC: integrate Redwood Dedicated in a VPC peering setup; wire a sandbox Zendesk + Stripe test account; run scripted spike tests (1k sustained, bursts 5k); validate tool-call idempotency, audit logs, and summary quality on a 500-record prompt set; measure p95 latency for path: user utterance -> tool-call completed -> ticket created (target p95 < 350ms)
